# ----------------------------- Entrypoint -----------------------------

def main():
    app = QtWidgets.QApplication(sys.argv)
    app.setQuitOnLastWindowClosed(False)
    if os.path.exists(ICON_PATH): app.setWindowIcon(QtGui.QIcon(ICON_PATH))
    config = ConfigManager(CONFIG_PATH)
    if not validate_or_welcome(config): return 0
    w = MainWindow(config); w.show()
    return app.exec()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

포인트 요약

  • Open Web 활성화 : 이제 프로세스가 살아있고 포트가 리스닝 중일 때만RUNNING 으로 전환 → 버튼 자동 활성화.

  • 임베디드 콘솔 : 각 카드의 Console 토글을 누르면 아래로 펼쳐지고, ANSI 색상 유지 해서 읽기 편함.

  • 리소스 절약 : 콘솔 펼쳤을 때만 tail 스레드를 시작하고, 접으면 정지.

원하는 콘솔 색 팔레트나 폰트/크기, 더 강한 ANSI 지원(배경색 등)이 필요하면 알려줘. Open Web을 RUNNING 전에도 강제 허용하고 싶으면 그 옵션도 바로 넣어줄 수 있어.

1. Instance Page가 길어지니 창도 같이 길어져. 길어지면 스크롤되게 해줘. 2. Console 창이 접힌 상태에서도 로그는 계속 쌓이는게 좋을 것 같아. 3. 자동으로 1개는 런 & Open Web 해주면 좋겠어. 4. run 하고 있다는 것이 좀 더 티가 나면 좋겠는데 예를 들어 STARTING. -> STARTING.. STARTING… 이렇게 1초마다 바뀐다든지 5. Console(ToolButton)은 qss가 안 먹었어.

awesome—here’s a polished single-file build that adds all five requests:

  • Instance list is inside a scrollable area (window height stays put; page scrolls).

  • Console keeps tailing even when collapsed (no UI freeze; colorized ANSI kept).

  • On first show, the launcher auto-creates one instance, starts it, and opens the web UI once it’s listening.

  • STARTING animation : the subtitle cycles STARTING. → STARTING.. → STARTING... every second.

  • QSS applies to the Console toggle (QToolButton) via an object name and dedicated style.

Drop-in ready. All strings/comments remain English.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
HyperFlow Launcher (Local ComfyUI Wrapper)
Modern UI + Scrollable instance list + In-card console (color) + Auto-start/open + STARTING animation

Platform: RHEL 8.x, Python 3.11, PySide6
"""

import json
import os
import signal
import sys
import threading
import time
import socket
import subprocess
import re
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Dict, Optional, List

from PySide6 import QtCore, QtGui, QtWidgets

# ----------------------- Constants / Defaults -----------------------

APP_NAME = "HyperFlow Launcher"
ICON_PATH = "/path/to/icon.png"        # Window & tray icon
BROWSER_PATH = "/path/to/chrome"       # Preferred browser executable
CONFIG_PATH = str(Path.home() / ".hyperflow_launcher.json")

COMFYUI_WORKDIR = os.environ.get("COMFYUI_WORKDIR", "/opt/comfyui")
COMFYUI_EXEC = os.environ.get(
    "COMFYUI_EXEC",
    "python3 main.py --listen --port {port}"
)  # {port} substituted

BIND_ADDR = "127.0.0.1"
MAX_INSTANCES = 8

# ----------------------- Utils: icon / ports -----------------------

def ensure_icon():
    if not os.path.exists(ICON_PATH):
        pass

def is_port_in_use(port: int, host: str = BIND_ADDR, timeout: float = 0.2) -> bool:
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
        s.settimeout(timeout)
        try:
            return s.connect_ex((host, port)) == 0
        except OSError:
            return False

def reserve_free_port(host: str = BIND_ADDR):
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
    s.bind((host, 0))
    port = s.getsockname()[1]
    return s, port

# ----------------------- ANSI -> HTML (basic) -----------------------

ANSI_RE = re.compile(r'\x1b\[((?:\d{1,3};?)+)m')

ANSI_STYLES = {
    '0':  'reset',
    '1':  'bold',
    # 30–37 fg, 90–97 bright fg
    '30': 'fg-0', '31': 'fg-1', '32': 'fg-2', '33': 'fg-3',
    '34': 'fg-4', '35': 'fg-5', '36': 'fg-6', '37': 'fg-7',
    '90': 'fg-8', '91': 'fg-9', '92': 'fg-10','93': 'fg-11',
    '94': 'fg-12','95': 'fg-13','96': 'fg-14','97': 'fg-15',
    '39': 'fg-reset',
}

FG_COLORS = {
    'fg-0':  '#000000',  'fg-1':  '#d32f2f',  'fg-2':  '#2e7d32',  'fg-3':  '#f9a825',
    'fg-4':  '#1565c0',  'fg-5':  '#6a1b9a',  'fg-6':  '#00838f',  'fg-7':  '#e0e0e0',
    'fg-8':  '#616161',  'fg-9':  '#ef5350',  'fg-10': '#66bb6a',  'fg-11': '#ffee58',
    'fg-12': '#42a5f5',  'fg-13': '#ab47bc',  'fg-14': '#26c6da',  'fg-15': '#ffffff',
}

def ansi_to_html(s: str) -> str:
    """
    Minimal ANSI SGR -> HTML converter for fg colors + bold.
    """
    parts = []
    last = 0
    open_tags: List[str] = []

    def close_all():
        nonlocal open_tags
        while open_tags:
            parts.append('</span>')
            open_tags.pop()

    for m in ANSI_RE.finditer(s):
        start, end = m.span()
        if start > last:
            literal = (s[last:start]
                       .replace('&', '&').replace('<', '<').replace('>', '>'))
            parts.append(literal)
        codes = m.group(1).split(';')
        for c in codes:
            key = ANSI_STYLES.get(c)
            if key == 'reset':
                close_all()
            elif key == 'bold':
                parts.append('<span style="font-weight:600">'); open_tags.append('bold')
            elif key and key.startswith('fg-'):
                color = FG_COLORS.get(key, '#ffffff')
                parts.append(f'<span style="color:{color}">'); open_tags.append(key)
            elif key == 'fg-reset':
                # Close all then reopen bold if previously active (simple approach)
                bold_active = any(tag == 'bold' for tag in open_tags)
                close_all()
                if bold_active:
                    parts.append('<span style="font-weight:600">'); open_tags.append('bold')
        last = end

    tail = s[last:].replace('&', '&').replace('<', '<').replace('>', '>')
    parts.append(tail)
    close_all()
    return '<pre style="margin:0;white-space:pre-wrap;">' + ''.join(parts) + '</pre>'

# ----------------------- Data classes / config -----------------------

@dataclass
class Instance:
    name: str
    port: int
    cwd: Path = field(default_factory=Path)
    log_path: Path = field(default_factory=Path)
    proc: Optional[subprocess.Popen] = None
    pgid: Optional[int] = None
    chrome_pids: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)
    status: str = "STOPPED"  # STARTING / RUNNING / STOPPED

class ConfigManager:
    def __init__(self, path: str):
        self.path = path
        self.data = {"data_dir": "", "browser_path": BROWSER_PATH}
        self.load()
    def load(self):
        if not os.path.exists(self.path): return
        try:
            with open(self.path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                self.data.update(json.load(f))
        except Exception:
            self.data = {"data_dir": "", "browser_path": BROWSER_PATH}
    def save(self):
        with open(self.path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(self.data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    @property
    def data_dir(self) -> Optional[Path]:
        dd = self.data.get("data_dir", ""); return Path(dd) if dd else None
    @property
    def browser_path(self) -> str:
        return self.data.get("browser_path") or BROWSER_PATH

# ----------------------- First-run welcome -----------------------

class WelcomeDialog(QtWidgets.QDialog):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.setWindowTitle("Welcome to HyperFlow!")
        self.setWindowIcon(QtGui.QIcon(ICON_PATH) if os.path.exists(ICON_PATH)
                           else self.style().standardIcon(QtWidgets.QStyle.SP_ComputerIcon))
        self.setModal(True); self.resize(520, 200)

        ); label.setWordWrap(True)

        self.path_edit = QtWidgets.QLineEdit(); self.path_edit.setPlaceholderText("Choose a directory for HyperFlow data…")
        browse_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Browse…"); browse_btn.clicked.connect(self.on_browse)

# ----------------------- Log tail thread -----------------------

class TailThread(QtCore.QThread):
    new_text = QtCore.Signal(str)
    def __init__(self, file_path: Path, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.file_path = file_path
        self._stop = threading.Event()
    def stop(self):
        self._stop.set()
    def run(self):
        try:
            with open(self.file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
                f.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)
                while not self._stop.is_set():
                    line = f.readline()
                    if not line:
                        time.sleep(0.25); continue
                    self.new_text.emit(line)
        except Exception as e:
            self.new_text.emit(f"\n[tail error] {e}\n")

# ----------------------- Stop worker -----------------------

class StopWorker(QtCore.QThread):
    finished_one = QtCore.Signal(int)    # port
    errored = QtCore.Signal(int, str)
    def __init__(self, inst: 'Instance', timeout_sec: float = 5.0, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent); self.inst = inst; self.timeout_sec = timeout_sec
    def run(self):
        inst = self.inst
        try:
            for pid in list(inst.chrome_pids):
                try: os.kill(pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                except ProcessLookupError: pass
            inst.chrome_pids.clear()
            if inst.proc is None:
                inst.status = "STOPPED"; self.finished_one.emit(inst.port); return
            try:
                if inst.pgid: os.killpg(inst.pgid, signal.SIGTERM)
                else: inst.proc.terminate()
            except ProcessLookupError: pass
            t0 = time.time()
            while time.time() - t0 < self.timeout_sec:
                if inst.proc.poll() is not None: break
                time.sleep(0.1)
            if inst.proc.poll() is None:
                try:
                    if inst.pgid: os.killpg(inst.pgid, signal.SIGKILL)
                    else: inst.proc.kill()
                except ProcessLookupError: pass
            inst.proc = None; inst.pgid = None; inst.status = "STOPPED"
            self.finished_one.emit(inst.port)
        except Exception as e:
            self.errored.emit(inst.port, str(e))

# ----------------------- Process manager -----------------------

class ProcessManagerLocal(QtCore.QObject):
    status_updated = QtCore.Signal()
    bulk_stop_finished = QtCore.Signal()

    def __init__(self, data_dir: Path, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.data_dir = data_dir
        self.instances: Dict[int, Instance] = {}
        (self.data_dir / "instances").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (self.data_dir / "logs").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (self.data_dir / "tmp").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        self.poll_timer = QtCore.QTimer(self)
        self.poll_timer.timeout.connect(self.poll_status)
        self.poll_timer.start(800)  # quick flip STARTING -> RUNNING when port is ready

        self._stop_workers: Dict[int, StopWorker] = {}
        self._bulk_stop_running = False
        self._bulk_pending_ports: List[int] = []

    def _alloc_os_free_port(self) -> int:
        s, port = reserve_free_port(BIND_ADDR); s.close(); return port

    def create_instance(self) -> Instance:
        if len(self.instances) >= MAX_INSTANCES:
            raise RuntimeError("Maximum number of instances reached.")
        port = self._alloc_os_free_port()
        if is_port_in_use(port):
            port = self._alloc_os_free_port()
        name = f"HyperFlow-{port}"
        cwd = self.data_dir / "instances" / name
        cwd.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        log_path = self.data_dir / "logs" / f"{name}.log"
        inst = Instance(name=name, port=port, cwd=cwd, log_path=log_path)
        self.instances[port] = inst
        return inst

    def start_instance(self, inst: Instance):
        if inst.proc and inst.proc.poll() is None: return
        if is_port_in_use(inst.port):
            s, new_port = reserve_free_port(BIND_ADDR); s.close()
            if is_port_in_use(new_port):
                QtWidgets.QMessageBox.critical(None, "Port Error", "Failed to acquire a free port. Please try again.")
                return
            inst.port = new_port
        cmd = COMFYUI_EXEC.format(port=inst.port)
        try:
            log_f = open(inst.log_path, "a", encoding="utf-8")
        except Exception as e:
            QtWidgets.QMessageBox.critical(None, "Log Error", f"Failed to open log file:\n{e}")
            return
        def preexec(): os.setsid()
        try:
            inst.status = "STARTING"
            proc = subprocess.Popen(
                cmd, shell=True, cwd=COMFYUI_WORKDIR,
                stdout=log_f, stderr=log_f, preexec_fn=preexec
            )
            inst.proc = proc
            try: inst.pgid = os.getpgid(proc.pid)
            except Exception: inst.pgid = None
        except Exception as e:
            inst.status = "STOPPED"
            QtWidgets.QMessageBox.critical(None, "Start Error", f"Failed to start instance:\n{e}")
        self.status_updated.emit()

    def stop_instance_async(self, inst: Instance, timeout_sec: float = 5.0):
        if inst.port in self._stop_workers and self._stop_workers[inst.port].isRunning(): return
        w = StopWorker(inst, timeout_sec)
        w.finished_one.connect(self._on_stop_finished)
        w.errored.connect(self._on_stop_errored)
        self._stop_workers[inst.port] = w
        w.start()

    @QtCore.Slot(int)
    def _on_stop_finished(self, port: int):
        self.status_updated.emit()
        if self._bulk_stop_running:
            self._bulk_pending_ports = [p for p in self._bulk_pending_ports if p != port]
            if not self._bulk_pending_ports:
                self._bulk_stop_running = False
                self.status_updated.emit()
                self.bulk_stop_finished.emit()

    @QtCore.Slot(int, str)
    def _on_stop_errored(self, port: int, msg: str):
        print(f"[stop-error] port={port} {msg}")
        self.status_updated.emit()
        if self._bulk_stop_running:
            self._bulk_pending_ports = [p for p in self._bulk_pending_ports if p != port]
            if not self._bulk_pending_ports:
                self._bulk_stop_running = False
                self.status_updated.emit()
                self.bulk_stop_finished.emit()

    def kill_all_async(self, timeout_sec: float = 5.0):
        running_ports = [inst.port for inst in self.instances.values()
                         if inst.proc is not None and inst.proc.poll() is None]
        if not running_ports:
            QtCore.QTimer.singleShot(0, self.bulk_stop_finished.emit); return
        self._bulk_stop_running = True
        self._bulk_pending_ports = list(running_ports)
        for p in running_ports:
            inst = self.instances.get(p)
            if inst: self.stop_instance_async(inst, timeout_sec)

    def poll_status(self):
        """RUNNING only when process is alive AND TCP port is accepting connections."""
        changed = False
        for inst in self.instances.values():
            prev = inst.status
            if inst.proc is None:
                if prev != "STOPPED":
                    inst.status = "STOPPED"; changed = True
                continue
            code = inst.proc.poll()
            if code is None:
                inst.status = "RUNNING" if is_port_in_use(inst.port) else "STARTING"
            else:
                inst.status = "STOPPED"
                inst.proc = None; inst.pgid = None
                for pid in list(inst.chrome_pids):
                    try: os.kill(pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                    except ProcessLookupError: pass
                inst.chrome_pids.clear()
            if inst.status != prev:
                changed = True
        if changed:
            self.status_updated.emit()

    def open_web(self, inst: Instance, browser_path: str):
        url = f"http://localhost:{inst.port}"
        try:
            p = subprocess.Popen([browser_path, url]); inst.chrome_pids.append(p.pid)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            QtWidgets.QMessageBox.warning(None, "Browser Not Found", f"The browser path is invalid:\n{browser_path}")

# ----------------------- UI: Cards with embedded console -----------------------

class InstanceCard(QtWidgets.QFrame):
    start_clicked = QtCore.Signal(int)
    stop_clicked = QtCore.Signal(int)
    openweb_clicked = QtCore.Signal(int)

    def __init__(self, inst: Instance, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.inst = inst
        self.setObjectName("card")
        self._anim_tick = 0  # for STARTING animation

        name_lbl = QtWidgets.QLabel(f"{inst.name}")
        name_lbl.setObjectName("h2")
        self.subtitle = QtWidgets.QLabel(self._subtitle_text())
        self.subtitle.setObjectName("subtle")

        self.start_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Start")
        self.stop_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Stop")
        self.web_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Open Web")

        self.start_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self.start_clicked.emit(inst.port))
        self.stop_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self.stop_clicked.emit(inst.port))
        self.web_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self.openweb_clicked.emit(inst.port))

        # Console toggle + view
        self.console_toggle = QtWidgets.QToolButton()
        self.console_toggle.setObjectName("consoleToggle")
        self.console_toggle.setText("Console")
        self.console_toggle.setCheckable(True)
        self.console_toggle.setArrowType(QtCore.Qt.RightArrow)
        self.console_toggle.setToolButtonStyle(QtCore.Qt.ToolButtonTextBesideIcon)
        self.console_toggle.toggled.connect(self._on_console_toggled)

        self.console_view = QtWidgets.QTextBrowser()
        self.console_view.setOpenLinks(False)
        self.console_view.setObjectName("console")
        self.console_view.setReadOnly(True)
        self.console_view.setHidden(True)
        self.console_view.document().setMaximumBlockCount(5000)  # safety cap

        # Tail thread always running (even when collapsed)
        self.tail_thread: Optional[TailThread] = TailThread(self.inst.log_path, self)
        self.tail_thread.new_text.connect(self._append_console_text)
        self.tail_thread.start()

        # STARTING animation timer (per-card)
        self.anim_timer = QtCore.QTimer(self)
        self.anim_timer.setInterval(1000)
        self.anim_timer.timeout.connect(self._animate_starting)
        self._sync_anim_timer()

        header = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout()
        header.addWidget(name_lbl); header.addStretch(); header.addWidget(self.subtitle)

        actions = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout()
        actions.addStretch()
        actions.addWidget(self.start_btn)
        actions.addWidget(self.stop_btn)
        actions.addWidget(self.web_btn)
        actions.addWidget(self.console_toggle)

        v = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(self)
        v.addLayout(header)
        v.addLayout(actions)
        v.addWidget(self.console_view)

        self.update_buttons()

    def _subtitle_text(self) -> str:
        status = self.inst.status
        if status == "STARTING":
            dots = "." * ((self._anim_tick % 3) + 1)
            return f"Port {self.inst.port} • Status: STARTING{dots}"
        else:
            return f"Port {self.inst.port} • Status: {status}"

    def _sync_anim_timer(self):
        if self.inst.status == "STARTING":
            if not self.anim_timer.isActive():
                self.anim_timer.start()
        else:
            if self.anim_timer.isActive():
                self.anim_timer.stop()

    def _animate_starting(self):
        if self.inst.status != "STARTING":
            self._sync_anim_timer(); return
        self._anim_tick += 1
        self.subtitle.setText(self._subtitle_text())

    def _on_console_toggled(self, checked: bool):
        self.console_toggle.setArrowType(QtCore.Qt.DownArrow if checked else QtCore.Qt.RightArrow)
        self.console_view.setHidden(not checked)

    @QtCore.Slot(str)
    def _append_console_text(self, line: str):
        # Always keep appending (even when collapsed)
        html = ansi_to_html(line)
        self.console_view.moveCursor(QtGui.QTextCursor.End)
        self.console_view.insertHtml(html)
        self.console_view.moveCursor(QtGui.QTextCursor.End)

    def update_view(self, inst: Instance):
        self.inst = inst
        self._sync_anim_timer()
        self.subtitle.setText(self._subtitle_text())
        self.update_buttons()

    def update_buttons(self):
        running = self.inst.status == "RUNNING"
        starting = self.inst.status == "STARTING"
        self.start_btn.setEnabled(not running and not starting)
        self.stop_btn.setEnabled(running or starting)
        self.web_btn.setEnabled(running)

    def close(self):
        # Ensure tail thread is stopped if card is destroyed
        try:
            if self.tail_thread:
                self.tail_thread.stop()
                self.tail_thread.wait(800)
        except Exception:
            pass
        super().close()

# ----------------------- Pages -----------------------

class HyperFlowPage(QtWidgets.QWidget):
    def __init__(self, procman: ProcessManagerLocal, browser_path: str, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.procman = procman
        self.browser_path = browser_path
        self._auto_open_done = False  # guard to open web exactly once for the auto-start instance

        title = QtWidgets.QLabel("HyperFlow"); title.setObjectName("h1")
        add_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("New Instance"); add_btn.setObjectName("primary"); add_btn.clicked.connect(self.on_add)

        header = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout(); header.addWidget(title); header.addStretch(); header.addWidget(add_btn)

        # Scrollable card area
        self.cards_container = QtWidgets.QWidget()
        self.cards_layout = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(self.cards_container)
        self.cards_layout.setSpacing(10); self.cards_layout.addStretch(1)

        scroll = QtWidgets.QScrollArea()
        scroll.setWidget(self.cards_container)
        scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        scroll.setFrameShape(QtWidgets.QFrame.NoFrame)
        scroll.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)

        outer = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(self)
        outer.addLayout(header); outer.addSpacing(8); outer.addWidget(scroll, 1)

        procman.status_updated.connect(self.refresh)

        # Ensure at least one card; auto-start + auto-open web
        if not self.procman.instances:
            first = self.on_add()
            if first:
                QtCore.QTimer.singleShot(50, lambda: self._auto_start_and_open(first))

        self.refresh()

    def on_add(self) -> Optional['InstanceCard']:
        try:
            inst = self.procman.create_instance()
        except Exception as e:
            QtWidgets.QMessageBox.warning(self, "Create Failed", str(e)); return None
        card = InstanceCard(inst)
        card.start_clicked.connect(self.on_start)
        card.stop_clicked.connect(self.on_stop)
        card.openweb_clicked.connect(self.on_openweb)

        # Insert above the stretch
        self.cards_layout.insertWidget(self.cards_layout.count() - 1, card)
        return card

    def _auto_start_and_open(self, card: 'InstanceCard'):
        inst = card.inst
        self.procman.start_instance(inst)

        # Hook once: when this instance becomes RUNNING, open the web
        def maybe_open():
            if self._auto_open_done:
                return
            cur = self.procman.instances.get(inst.port)
            if cur and cur.status == "RUNNING":
                self._auto_open_done = True
                self.procman.open_web(cur, self.browser_path)
                try:
                    self.procman.status_updated.disconnect(maybe_open)
                except Exception:
                    pass

        self.procman.status_updated.connect(maybe_open)

    def on_start(self, port: int):
        inst = self.procman.instances.get(port)
        if inst: self.procman.start_instance(inst)

    def on_stop(self, port: int):
        inst = self.procman.instances.get(port)
        if inst: self.procman.stop_instance_async(inst)

    def on_openweb(self, port: int):
        inst = self.procman.instances.get(port)
        if inst: self.procman.open_web(inst, self.browser_path)

    @QtCore.Slot()
    def refresh(self):
        # Update all cards
        for i in range(self.cards_layout.count() - 1):  # skip the final stretch
            w = self.cards_layout.itemAt(i).widget()
            if isinstance(w, InstanceCard):
                inst = self.procman.instances.get(w.inst.port)
                if inst: w.update_view(inst)

class SettingsWidget(QtWidgets.QWidget):
    request_restart = QtCore.Signal(Path)
    def __init__(self, config: ConfigManager, parent=None):

class MainWindow(QtWidgets.QMainWindow):
    def __init__(self, config: ConfigManager):
        super().__init__(); self.config = config
        self.setWindowTitle(APP_NAME); ensure_icon()
        if os.path.exists(ICON_PATH): self.setWindowIcon(QtGui.QIcon(ICON_PATH))

        self.sidebar = Sidebar(); self.sidebar.indexChanged.connect(self.on_sidebar_index)
        self.procman = ProcessManagerLocal(config.data_dir)
        self.page_hf = HyperFlowPage(self.procman, config.browser_path)
        self.page_settings = SettingsWidget(config); self.page_settings.request_restart.connect(self.on_request_restart)

        self.stack = QtWidgets.QStackedWidget(); self.stack.addWidget(self.page_hf); self.stack.addWidget(self.page_settings)

        content_wrap = QtWidgets.QFrame(); content_wrap.setObjectName("content")
        content_layout = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(content_wrap); content_layout.setContentsMargins(16,16,16,16); content_layout.addWidget(self.stack)

        central = QtWidgets.QWidget(); h = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout(central); h.setContentsMargins(0,0,0,0); h.setSpacing(0)
        h.addWidget(self.sidebar); h.addWidget(content_wrap, 1); self.setCentralWidget(central)

        self._create_tray()
        self.resize(1120, 720)
        tweak_qss(self)

    def on_sidebar_index(self, idx: int): self.stack.setCurrentIndex(idx)

    def _create_tray(self):
        self.tray = QtWidgets.QSystemTrayIcon(self)
        icon = QtGui.QIcon(ICON_PATH) if os.path.exists(ICON_PATH) else self.style().standardIcon(QtWidgets.QStyle.SP_ComputerIcon)
        self.tray.setIcon(icon); self.tray.setToolTip(APP_NAME); self.tray.activated.connect(self.on_tray_activated)
        menu = QtWidgets.QMenu(); show_act = menu.addAction("Show Window"); quit_act = menu.addAction("Quit")
        show_act.triggered.connect(self.show_normal_from_tray); quit_act.triggered.connect(self.quit_app)
        self.tray.setContextMenu(menu); self.tray.show()

    def on_tray_activated(self, reason):
        if reason == QtWidgets.QSystemTrayIcon.DoubleClick: self.show_normal_from_tray()

    def show_normal_from_tray(self):
        self.show(); self.setWindowState(self.windowState() & ~QtCore.Qt.WindowMinimized | QtCore.Qt.WindowActive)
        self.raise_(); self.activateWindow()

    def closeEvent(self, e: QtGui.QCloseEvent):
        ret = QtWidgets.QMessageBox.question(self, "Exit", "Keep running in the system tray?\nClick 'No' to quit.",
                                             QtWidgets.QMessageBox.Yes | QtWidgets.QMessageBox.No, QtWidgets.QMessageBox.Yes)
        if ret == QtWidgets.QMessageBox.Yes: e.ignore(); self.hide()
        else: e.ignore(); self.quit_app()

    def on_request_restart(self, new_dir: Path):
        self.config.data["data_dir"] = str(new_dir); self.config.save()
        QtWidgets.QMessageBox.information(self, "Restart Required", "Settings changed. The launcher will restart now.")
        self._restart_self()

    def _restart_self(self):
        python = sys.executable; args = sys.argv[:]
        QtCore.QProcess.startDetached(python, args); self.quit_app(force=True)

    def quit_app(self, force: bool = False):
        if force: QtWidgets.QApplication.quit(); return
        def _finish(): QtWidgets.QApplication.quit()
        try: self.procman.bulk_stop_finished.disconnect()
        except Exception: pass
        self.procman.bulk_stop_finished.connect(_finish); self.procman.kill_all_async()

# ----------------------- First-run validation -----------------------

def validate_or_welcome(config: ConfigManager) -> bool:
    dd = config.data_dir
    if dd and dd.exists() and dd.is_dir(): return True
    dlg = WelcomeDialog()
    if dlg.exec() != QtWidgets.QDialog.Accepted: return False
    sel = dlg.selected_path()
    if not sel: return False
    p = Path(sel)
    if not p.exists():
        try: p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except Exception as e:
            QtWidgets.QMessageBox.critical(None, "Error", f"Failed to create directory:\n{e}"); return False
    for sub in ("instances", "logs", "tmp"): (p / sub).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    config.data["data_dir"] = str(p); config.save(); return True

quick recap of your 5 asks

  1. Scrollable instances : the list sits in a QScrollArea, so the window won’t grow; it scrolls instead.

  2. Console tails when collapsed : each card starts a TailThread once and keeps appending to the hidden QTextBrowser.

  3. Auto-run & open web: first card auto-starts; once the port is listening, the browser launches exactly once.

  4. STARTING animation : per-card timer updates the subtitle with cycling dots every second.

  5. ToolButton QSS : added objectName="consoleToggle" and QSS rules for QToolButton#consoleToggle.

If you want the auto-start to be optional or choose a specific browser path per user, I can add toggles in Settings.

totally—QScrollArea needs a couple of extra selectors because of its viewport.
Drop these QSS additions under your dark theme to make the list area transparent (and keep the scrollbars):

Option A — fully transparent scroll area

/* QScrollArea: make the container and its viewport transparent */
QScrollArea {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;              /* we already hide the frame in code, this is a safety net */
}

/* QAbstractScrollArea base also owns the viewport subcontrol */
QAbstractScrollArea {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
}

/* The actual paint target inside QScrollArea */
QAbstractScrollArea::viewport {
    background: transparent;
}

/* If you gave the inner widget an objectName, un-comment and use this too:
QWidget#cardsContainer {
    background: transparent;
}
*/

Option B — subtle dark panel (if you want a faint panel instead of full transparent)

/* Slightly lifted panel behind the cards */
QScrollArea {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
}
QAbstractScrollArea::viewport {
    background: #0E1217;       /* just a hair lighter than #0F1115 */
    border: 1px solid #1A2029;
    border-radius: 10px;
}

/* Optional: add inner padding spacing */
QScrollArea {
    padding: 6px;              /* creates breathing room around the viewport */
}

Tip: your code already does scroll.setFrameShape(QFrame::NoFrame), which helps. If you want even tighter control, set the inner widget’s name once:

…then use the commented #cardsContainer rule above.

ok—Qt’s scroll area can be stubborn. Two things usually block transparency:

  1. the viewport paints an opaque background, and

  2. the inner widget chain under QScrollArea keeps a default background.

Here’s a small, surgical fix that works reliably in PySide6. Do both the code patch and the QSS tweak.

1) Tiny code patch (right after you build the scroll area)

# after creating the scroll area and inner widget
self.cards_container.setObjectName("cardsContainer")

scroll = QtWidgets.QScrollArea()
scroll.setWidget(self.cards_container)
scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
scroll.setFrameShape(QtWidgets.QFrame.NoFrame)
scroll.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)

# --- critical: make every layer transparent programmatically ---
scroll.setStyleSheet("background: transparent; border: none;")
scroll.viewport().setStyleSheet("background: transparent;")
self.cards_container.setStyleSheet("background: transparent;")

# Some styles ignore QSS for the viewport; force palette-based transparency:
pal = scroll.viewport().palette()
pal.setColor(QtGui.QPalette.Base, QtCore.Qt.transparent)
scroll.viewport().setPalette(pal)

# Make sure nothing auto-fills an opaque background:
scroll.viewport().setAutoFillBackground(False)
self.cards_container.setAutoFillBackground(False)

# If your platform style still paints, allow styled bg on the inner widget:
self.cards_container.setAttribute(QtCore.Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)

If you wrap the cards in another intermediate widget, apply the same setStyleSheet("background: transparent;") to that widget too.

2) Add these QSS rules (append to your dark theme)

/* QScrollArea: force a transparent stack from container → viewport → inner widget */
QScrollArea {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
}
QAbstractScrollArea {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
}
QAbstractScrollArea::viewport {
    background: transparent;
}

/* Qt inserts an extra QWidget under QScrollArea. Target both levels. */
QScrollArea > QWidget {
    background: transparent;
}
QScrollArea > QWidget > QWidget {
    background: transparent;
}

/* Your actual inner widget holding the cards */
QWidget#cardsContainer {
    background: transparent;
}

Why this works

  • Some Qt styles (Fusion, platform themes) ignore QSS for the viewport’s base color; setting the palette to Qt.transparent closes that gap.

  • The nested> QWidget > QWidget selectors catch the anonymous child Qt inserts under QScrollArea.

  • Disabling AutoFillBackground prevents a default fill from repainting over your transparent style.

If it still paints, tell me your platform theme/style, and I’ll give you a minimal style override (e.g., switch to Fusion for a quick test) or a fallback with a 1-pixel alpha panel instead of full transparency.

핵심: cards_container에는 투명 QSS를 주지 말고 , 오직 QScrollArea와 viewport만 투명.
그리고 배경을 가져야 하는 위젯(카드/콘솔) 에는 WA_StyledBackground 를 켜서 QSS 배경이 반드시 칠해지게 합니다.

B) QSS 수정 (너무 광범위한 선택자 제거)

이전에 제안했던 다음 규칙은 삭제 하거나 주석 처리하세요. (이게 카드까지 투명하게 만들 수 있어요)

정리

  • 투명 처리는 QScrollArea/viewport까지만.

  • cards_container는 투명 X (중립), 카드/콘솔은WA_StyledBackground=True 로 QSS 배경을 강제 렌더.

  • 넓은 QScrollArea > QWidget > QWidget 선택자는 삭제.

이대로 하면 배경은 그대로 어둡게 유지되고, 스크롤 영역만 자연스럽게 바탕과 어울립니다.

그냥 처음의 라이트 모드 theme가 더 나은것 같아서 그걸로 돌릴게, (대신 Scroll 관련 위젯들을 autoFillBackground=False로 줬어) 그리고 log 파일을 읽는데서 에러가 나는데 QProcess로 그냥 출력을 바로 콘솔 창에 프린트하는게 낫지 않아?

좋아. 로그 파일 tail →QProcess 직결로 바꾼 깔끔한 방법을 정리해줄게.
(라이트 테마/스크롤 오토필 조정은 그대로 두고, 필요한 부분만 교체하면 된다.)

아래는 핵심 변경점만 모아서 준 “드롭인 패치”야.
파일 전체를 갈아엎을 필요 없이, 이 블록들만 기존 코드에 반영해.

1) Instance 모델에 QProcess/로그 핸들 추가

from PySide6 import QtCore

@dataclass
class Instance:
    name: str
    port: int
    cwd: Path = field(default_factory=Path)
    log_path: Path = field(default_factory=Path)
    proc: Optional[QtCore.QProcess] = None   # ← QProcess로 교체
    pid: Optional[int] = None                # QProcess PID 캐시
    chrome_pids: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)
    status: str = "STOPPED"                  # STARTING / RUNNING / STOPPED
    log_fh: Optional[object] = None          # 파일로도 남기고 싶으면(선택)

2) ProcessManagerLocal — QProcess로 실행/로그 파이프

2-1) 시그널 추가

class ProcessManagerLocal(QtCore.QObject):
    status_updated = QtCore.Signal()
    bulk_stop_finished = QtCore.Signal()
    log_received = QtCore.Signal(int, str)   # (port, text) → 카드에서 받아 콘솔에 append

2-2) 시작 로직 교체 (start_instance)

def start_instance(self, inst: Instance):
    if inst.proc and inst.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning:
        return

    # 포트 충돌 마지막 점검
    if is_port_in_use(inst.port):
        s, new_port = reserve_free_port(BIND_ADDR); s.close()
        if is_port_in_use(new_port):
            QtWidgets.QMessageBox.critical(None, "Port Error", "Failed to acquire a free port. Please try again.")
            return
        inst.port = new_port

    cmd = COMFYUI_EXEC.format(port=inst.port)

    # QProcess 준비
    p = QtCore.QProcess(self)
    p.setWorkingDirectory(COMFYUI_WORKDIR)
    # stdout/stderr를 분리해서 받을 수도 있지만, 단순화 위해 합치자
    p.setProcessChannelMode(QtCore.QProcess.MergedChannels)
    # Bash -lc 로 실행하면 쉘 확장/환경활용 가능
    p.setProgram("/bin/bash")
    p.setArguments(["-lc", cmd])

    # readyRead 핸들러: 즉시 읽어 색 변환 후 시그널로 전달 + 선택적으로 파일에 기록
    def _on_ready():
        try:
            data = bytes(p.readAllStandardOutput()).decode("utf-8", "ignore")
        except Exception:
            return
        if not data:
            return
        # 파일로도 남기고 싶으면(옵션)
        if inst.log_fh is None:
            try:
                inst.log_fh = open(inst.log_path, "a", encoding="utf-8")
            except Exception:
                inst.log_fh = None
        if inst.log_fh:
            inst.log_fh.write(data); inst.log_fh.flush()
        # UI로 보냄
        self.log_received.emit(inst.port, data)

    p.readyReadStandardOutput.connect(_on_ready)

    # 종료/크래시 핸들
    def _on_finished(code, status):
        # 파일 핸들 닫기
        if inst.log_fh:
            try: inst.log_fh.close()
            except Exception: pass
            inst.log_fh = None
        inst.proc = None
        inst.pid = None
        inst.status = "STOPPED"
        # 혹시 남은 브라우저 종료
        for pid in list(inst.chrome_pids):
            try: os.kill(pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            except ProcessLookupError: pass
        inst.chrome_pids.clear()
        self.status_updated.emit()
        # 벌크 종료 중이면 카운트다운 로직은 기존 kill_all_async 쪽에서 처리

    p.finished.connect(_on_finished)

    # 시작
    inst.status = "STARTING"
    p.start()
    if not p.waitForStarted(3000):   # 블로킹 X, 내부 폴링. 3초 정도만 확인
        QtWidgets.QMessageBox.critical(None, "Start Error", "Failed to start process.")
        inst.status = "STOPPED"
        return

    inst.proc = p
    inst.pid = int(p.processId()) if p.processId() is not None else None
    self.status_updated.emit()

2-3) 정지 로직 단순화 (QThread 없이 타이머로 비동기 종료)

def stop_instance_async(self, inst: Instance, timeout_sec: float = 5.0):
    if not inst.proc:
        return
    # 1) 그레이스풀
    try:
        inst.proc.terminate()  # SIGTERM
    except Exception:
        pass

    # 2) timeout 뒤에도 살아있으면 SIGKILL
    pid = inst.pid
    def _force_kill():
        if inst.proc and inst.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning:
            if pid:
                try: os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                except ProcessLookupError: pass
            try: inst.proc.kill()
            except Exception: pass
    QtCore.QTimer.singleShot(int(timeout_sec * 1000), _force_kill)

2-4) 전체 종료 (kill_all_async) 는 각 인스턴스에 위 함수 호출

def kill_all_async(self, timeout_sec: float = 5.0):
    running_ports = [inst.port for inst in self.instances.values()
                     if inst.proc and inst.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning]
    if not running_ports:
        QtCore.QTimer.singleShot(0, self.bulk_stop_finished.emit); return

    # 완료 체크를 간단히: 주기적으로 상태 보고 → 모두 STOPPED면 emit
    self._bulk_stop_check_timer = getattr(self, "_bulk_stop_check_timer", QtCore.QTimer(self))
    self._bulk_stop_check_timer.setInterval(300)
    def _tick():
        alive = [inst for inst in self.instances.values()
                 if inst.proc and inst.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning]
        if not alive:
            self._bulk_stop_check_timer.stop()
            self.bulk_stop_finished.emit()
    self._bulk_stop_check_timer.timeout.connect(_tick)
    self._bulk_stop_check_timer.start()

    for inst in self.instances.values():
        if inst.proc and inst.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning:
            self.stop_instance_async(inst, timeout_sec)

2-5) 상태 폴링은 포트 리스닝 + QProcess 상태를 함께 반영

def poll_status(self):
    changed = False
    for inst in self.instances.values():
        prev = inst.status
        if not inst.proc or inst.proc.state() == QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning:
            if prev != "STOPPED":
                inst.status = "STOPPED"; changed = True
            continue

        # 프로세스 살아있으면 리스닝 여부로 RUNNING/STARTING 구분
        inst.status = "RUNNING" if is_port_in_use(inst.port) else "STARTING"
        if inst.status != prev:
            changed = True
    if changed:
        self.status_updated.emit()

4) (선택) 로그 파일도 남기고 싶다면

위 start_instance()에서 inst.log_fh를 열어두고, readyRead에서 들어온 텍스트를 동시에 self.log_received.emit()과 파일에 write() 해주면 끝.
에러가 나던 “파일 tail”은 더 이상 쓰지 않으니 사라져.

왜 이게 좋은가

  • 파일 I/O 의존 제거 : QProcess 스트림을 바로 UI로 보내므로 파일 잠금/권한/경로 문제에서 자유롭다.

  • 프리즈 없음 : readyRead…는 Qt 이벤트 루프에서 비동기로 호출 → 즉시 HTML 변환해 QTextBrowser에 append.

  • 접힘 상태에서도 계속 기록 : 카드가 콘솔을 숨겨도 receiver는 계속 붙어 있으므로 자연스럽게 누적.

  • 종료도 비동기 : terminate() 후 타이머로 강제 kill → UI는 즉시 응답.

필요하면 이 변경을 반영한 전체 파일 도 만들어 줄 수 있어. 지금은 요청하신 포인트(로그를 QProcess로 직결)만 최소 수정으로 정리했어.

설치 가능한 패키지로 만들어줘. icon를 내부 assets 안에 넣고 싶어.

import re
from typing import List

# Minimal ANSI SGR → HTML (foreground colors + bold)
_ANSI_RE = re.compile(r'\x1b\[((?:\d{1,3};?)+)m')

_STYLES = {
    '0':  'reset',
    '1':  'bold',
    '30': 'fg-0', '31': 'fg-1', '32': 'fg-2', '33': 'fg-3',
    '34': 'fg-4', '35': 'fg-5', '36': 'fg-6', '37': 'fg-7',
    '90': 'fg-8', '91': 'fg-9', '92': 'fg-10','93': 'fg-11',
    '94': 'fg-12','95': 'fg-13','96': 'fg-14','97': 'fg-15',
    '39': 'fg-reset',
}

_COLORS = {
    'fg-0':  '#000000',  'fg-1':  '#d32f2f',  'fg-2':  '#2e7d32',  'fg-3':  '#f9a825',
    'fg-4':  '#1565c0',  'fg-5':  '#6a1b9a',  'fg-6':  '#00838f',  'fg-7':  '#e0e0e0',
    'fg-8':  '#616161',  'fg-9':  '#ef5350',  'fg-10': '#66bb6a',  'fg-11': '#ffee58',
    'fg-12': '#42a5f5',  'fg-13': '#ab47bc',  'fg-14': '#26c6da',  'fg-15': '#ffffff',
}

def ansi_to_html(s: str) -> str:
    """Convert basic ANSI SGR codes to HTML spans (fg colors + bold)."""
    parts: List[str] = []
    last = 0
    open_tags: List[str] = []

    def close_all():
        nonlocal open_tags
        while open_tags:
            parts.append("</span>")
            open_tags.pop()

    for m in _ANSI_RE.finditer(s):
        start, end = m.span()
        if start > last:
            literal = (s[last:start]
                       .replace("&", "&")
                       .replace("<", "<")
                       .replace(">", ">"))
            parts.append(literal)
        codes = m.group(1).split(";")
        for c in codes:
            key = _STYLES.get(c)
            if key == "reset":
                close_all()
            elif key == "bold":
                parts.append('<span style="font-weight:600">'); open_tags.append("bold")
            elif key and key.startswith("fg-"):
                color = _COLORS.get(key, "#ffffff")
                parts.append(f'<span style="color:{color}">'); open_tags.append(key)
            elif key == "fg-reset":
                bold_active = any(tag == "bold" for tag in open_tags)
                close_all()
                if bold_active:
                    parts.append('<span style="font-weight:600">'); open_tags.append("bold")
        last = end

    tail = (s[last:]
            .replace("&", "&")
            .replace("<", "<")
            .replace(">", ">"))
    parts.append(tail)
    close_all()
    return '<pre style="margin:0;white-space:pre-wrap;">' + "".join(parts) + "</pre>"

def app_icon() -> QtGui.QIcon: """Load icon from package assets; fallback to system icon if missing.""" try: icon_data = (resources.files(package) / "assets" / "icon.png").read_bytes() pm = QtGui.QPixmap() if pm.loadFromData(icon_data): return QtGui.QIcon(pm) except Exception: pass return QtWidgets.QApplication.style().standardIcon(QtWidgets.QStyle.SP_ComputerIcon)

def is_port_in_use(port: int, host: str = BIND_ADDR, timeout: float = 0.2) -> bool: with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s: s.settimeout(timeout) try: return s.connect_ex((host, port)) == 0 except OSError: return False

def reserve_free_port(host: str = BIND_ADDR) -> int: s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1) s.bind((host, 0)) port = s.getsockname()[1] s.close() return port

@dataclass class Instance: name: str port: int cwd: Path = field(default_factory=Path) log_path: Path = field(default_factory=Path) proc: Optional[QtCore.QProcess] = None pid: Optional[int] = None chrome_pids: List[int] = field(default_factory=list) status: str = "STOPPED" # STARTING / RUNNING / STOPPED log_fh: Optional[object] = None # optional: still write to file

class ConfigManager: def init(self, path: str): self.path = path self.data = {"data_dir": "", "browser_path": BROWSER_DEFAULT} self.load()

def load(self):
    if not os.path.exists(self.path):
        return
    try:
        with open(self.path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            self.data.update(json.load(f))
    except Exception:
        self.data = {"data_dir": "", "browser_path": BROWSER_DEFAULT}

def save(self):
    with open(self.path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(self.data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

@property
def data_dir(self) -> Optional[Path]:
    dd = self.data.get("data_dir", "")
    return Path(dd) if dd else None

@property
def browser_path(self) -> str:
    return self.data.get("browser_path") or BROWSER_DEFAULT

———————– Process manager (QProcess logging) ———————–

class ProcessManagerLocal(QtCore.QObject): status_updated = QtCore.Signal() bulk_stop_finished = QtCore.Signal() log_received = QtCore.Signal(int, str) # (port, text)

def __init__(self, data_dir: Path, parent=None):
    super().__init__(parent)
    self.data_dir = data_dir
    self.instances: Dict[int, Instance] = {}
    (self.data_dir / "instances").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (self.data_dir / "logs").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (self.data_dir / "tmp").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # faster tick so STARTING→RUNNING flips as soon as port is listening
    self.poll_timer = QtCore.QTimer(self)
    self.poll_timer.timeout.connect(self.poll_status)
    self.poll_timer.start(800)

    self._bulk_stop_check_timer: Optional[QtCore.QTimer] = None

def create_instance(self) -> Instance:
    if len(self.instances) >= MAX_INSTANCES:
        raise RuntimeError("Maximum number of instances reached.")
    port = reserve_free_port(BIND_ADDR)
    if is_port_in_use(port):
        port = reserve_free_port(BIND_ADDR)
    name = f"HyperFlow-{port}"
    cwd = self.data_dir / "instances" / name
    cwd.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    log_path = self.data_dir / "logs" / f"{name}.log"
    inst = Instance(name=name, port=port, cwd=cwd, log_path=log_path)
    self.instances[port] = inst
    return inst

def start_instance(self, inst: Instance):
    if inst.proc and inst.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning:
        return
    if is_port_in_use(inst.port):
        new_port = reserve_free_port(BIND_ADDR)
        if is_port_in_use(new_port):
            QtWidgets.QMessageBox.critical(None, "Port Error", "Failed to acquire a free port. Please try again.")
            return
        inst.port = new_port

    cmd = COMFYUI_EXEC.format(port=inst.port)

    p = QtCore.QProcess(self)
    p.setWorkingDirectory(COMFYUI_WORKDIR)
    p.setProcessChannelMode(QtCore.QProcess.MergedChannels)
    p.setProgram("/bin/bash")
    p.setArguments(["-lc", cmd])

    def _on_ready():
        try:
            data = bytes(p.readAllStandardOutput()).decode("utf-8", "ignore")
        except Exception:
            return
        if not data:
            return
        # (optional) also persist to file
        if inst.log_fh is None:
            try:
                inst.log_fh = open(inst.log_path, "a", encoding="utf-8")
            except Exception:
                inst.log_fh = None
        if inst.log_fh:
            try:
                inst.log_fh.write(data); inst.log_fh.flush()
            except Exception:
                pass
        self.log_received.emit(inst.port, data)

    def _on_finished(code, status):
        if inst.log_fh:
            try: inst.log_fh.close()
            except Exception: pass
            inst.log_fh = None
        inst.proc = None
        inst.pid = None
        inst.status = "STOPPED"
        for pid in list(inst.chrome_pids):
            try: os.kill(pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            except ProcessLookupError: pass
        inst.chrome_pids.clear()
        self.status_updated.emit()

    p.readyReadStandardOutput.connect(_on_ready)
    p.finished.connect(_on_finished)

    inst.status = "STARTING"
    p.start()
    if not p.waitForStarted(3000):
        QtWidgets.QMessageBox.critical(None, "Start Error", "Failed to start process.")
        inst.status = "STOPPED"
        return
    inst.proc = p
    inst.pid = int(p.processId()) if p.processId() is not None else None
    self.status_updated.emit()

def stop_instance_async(self, inst: Instance, timeout_sec: float = 5.0):
    if not inst.proc:
        return
    try:
        inst.proc.terminate()
    except Exception:
        pass
    pid = inst.pid

    def _force_kill():
        if inst.proc and inst.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning:
            if pid:
                try: os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                except ProcessLookupError: pass
            try: inst.proc.kill()
            except Exception: pass

    QtCore.QTimer.singleShot(int(timeout_sec * 1000), _force_kill)

def kill_all_async(self, timeout_sec: float = 5.0):
    running = [i for i in self.instances.values() if i.proc and i.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning]
    if not running:
        QtCore.QTimer.singleShot(0, self.bulk_stop_finished.emit)
        return

    if self._bulk_stop_check_timer is None:
        self._bulk_stop_check_timer = QtCore.QTimer(self)

    self._bulk_stop_check_timer.setInterval(300)

    def _tick():
        alive = [i for i in self.instances.values() if i.proc and i.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning]
        if not alive:
            self._bulk_stop_check_timer.stop()
            self.bulk_stop_finished.emit()

    try:
        self._bulk_stop_check_timer.timeout.disconnect()
    except Exception:
        pass
    self._bulk_stop_check_timer.timeout.connect(_tick)
    self._bulk_stop_check_timer.start()

    for inst in running:
        self.stop_instance_async(inst, timeout_sec)

def poll_status(self):
    changed = False
    for inst in self.instances.values():
        prev = inst.status
        if not inst.proc or inst.proc.state() == QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning:
            if prev != "STOPPED":
                inst.status = "STOPPED"; changed = True
            continue
        inst.status = "RUNNING" if is_port_in_use(inst.port) else "STARTING"
        if inst.status != prev:
            changed = True
    if changed:
        self.status_updated.emit()

def open_web(self, inst: Instance, browser_path: str):
    url = f"http://localhost:{inst.port}"
    try:
        p = subprocess.Popen([browser_path, url])
        inst.chrome_pids.append(p.pid)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        QtWidgets.QMessageBox.warning(None, "Browser Not Found", f"The browser path is invalid:\n{browser_path}")

class InstanceCard(QtWidgets.QFrame): start_clicked = QtCore.Signal(int) stop_clicked = QtCore.Signal(int) openweb_clicked = QtCore.Signal(int)

def __init__(self, inst: Instance, procman: ProcessManagerLocal, parent=None):
    super().__init__(parent)
    self.inst = inst
    self.procman = procman
    self.setObjectName("card")
    self.setAttribute(QtCore.Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
    self._anim_tick = 0

    name_lbl = QtWidgets.QLabel(f"{inst.name}"); name_lbl.setObjectName("h2")
    self.subtitle = QtWidgets.QLabel(self._subtitle_text()); self.subtitle.setObjectName("subtle")

    self.start_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Start")
    self.stop_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Stop")
    self.web_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Open Web")

    self.start_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self.start_clicked.emit(inst.port))
    self.stop_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self.stop_clicked.emit(inst.port))
    self.web_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self.openweb_clicked.emit(inst.port))

    # Console toggle + view
    self.console_toggle = QtWidgets.QToolButton()
    self.console_toggle.setObjectName("consoleToggle")
    self.console_toggle.setText("Console")
    self.console_toggle.setCheckable(True)
    self.console_toggle.setArrowType(QtCore.Qt.RightArrow)
    self.console_toggle.setToolButtonStyle(QtCore.Qt.ToolButtonTextBesideIcon)
    self.console_toggle.toggled.connect(self._on_console_toggled)

    self.console_view = QtWidgets.QTextBrowser()
    self.console_view.setObjectName("console")
    self.console_view.setReadOnly(True)
    self.console_view.setHidden(True)
    self.console_view.document().setMaximumBlockCount(5000)
    self.console_view.setAutoFillBackground(False)

    header = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout()
    header.addWidget(name_lbl); header.addStretch(); header.addWidget(self.subtitle)

    actions = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout()
    actions.addStretch()
    actions.addWidget(self.start_btn)
    actions.addWidget(self.stop_btn)
    actions.addWidget(self.web_btn)
    actions.addWidget(self.console_toggle)

    v = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(self)
    v.addLayout(header)
    v.addLayout(actions)
    v.addWidget(self.console_view)

    # STARTING animation timer
    self.anim_timer = QtCore.QTimer(self)
    self.anim_timer.setInterval(1000)
    self.anim_timer.timeout.connect(self._animate_starting)
    self._sync_anim_timer()

    # connect live logs
    self.procman.log_received.connect(self._on_log)

    self.update_buttons()

def _subtitle_text(self) -> str:
    if self.inst.status == "STARTING":
        dots = "." * ((self._anim_tick % 3) + 1)
        return f"Port {self.inst.port} • Status: STARTING{dots}"
    return f"Port {self.inst.port} • Status: {self.inst.status}"

def _sync_anim_timer(self):
    if self.inst.status == "STARTING" and not self.anim_timer.isActive():
        self.anim_timer.start()
    elif self.inst.status != "STARTING" and self.anim_timer.isActive():
        self.anim_timer.stop()

def _animate_starting(self):
    if self.inst.status != "STARTING":
        self._sync_anim_timer(); return
    self._anim_tick += 1
    self.subtitle.setText(self._subtitle_text())

def _on_console_toggled(self, checked: bool):
    self.console_toggle.setArrowType(QtCore.Qt.DownArrow if checked else QtCore.Qt.RightArrow)
    self.console_view.setHidden(not checked)

@QtCore.Slot(int, str)
def _on_log(self, port: int, text: str):
    if port != self.inst.port:
        return
    html = ansi_to_html(text)
    self.console_view.moveCursor(QtGui.QTextCursor.End)
    self.console_view.insertHtml(html)
    self.console_view.moveCursor(QtGui.QTextCursor.End)

def update_view(self, inst: Instance):
    self.inst = inst
    self._sync_anim_timer()
    self.subtitle.setText(self._subtitle_text())
    self.update_buttons()

def update_buttons(self):
    running = self.inst.status == "RUNNING"
    starting = self.inst.status == "STARTING"
    self.start_btn.setEnabled(not running and not starting)
    self.stop_btn.setEnabled(running or starting)
    self.web_btn.setEnabled(running)

class HyperFlowPage(QtWidgets.QWidget): def init(self, procman: ProcessManagerLocal, browser_path: str, parent=None): super().init(parent) self.procman = procman self.browser_path = browser_path self._auto_open_done = False

    title = QtWidgets.QLabel("HyperFlow"); title.setObjectName("h1")
    add_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("New Instance"); add_btn.setObjectName("primary"); add_btn.clicked.connect(self.on_add)

    header = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout(); header.addWidget(title); header.addStretch(); header.addWidget(add_btn)

    # Scrollable card list
    self.cards_container = QtWidgets.QWidget()
    self.cards_layout = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(self.cards_container)
    self.cards_layout.setSpacing(10); self.cards_layout.addStretch(1)

    scroll = QtWidgets.QScrollArea()
    scroll.setWidget(self.cards_container)
    scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
    scroll.setFrameShape(QtWidgets.QFrame.NoFrame)
    scroll.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
    # prevent opaque repaint from styles
    scroll.setAutoFillBackground(False)
    scroll.viewport().setAutoFillBackground(False)

    outer = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(self)
    outer.addLayout(header)
    outer.addSpacing(8)
    outer.addWidget(scroll, 1)

    procman.status_updated.connect(self.refresh)

    # ensure at least one card; auto-start + auto-open web once RUNNING
    if not self.procman.instances:
        card = self.on_add()
        if card:
            QtCore.QTimer.singleShot(50, lambda: self._auto_start_and_open(card))

    self.refresh()

def on_add(self) -> Optional[InstanceCard]:
    try:
        inst = self.procman.create_instance()
    except Exception as e:
        QtWidgets.QMessageBox.warning(self, "Create Failed", str(e)); return None
    card = InstanceCard(inst, self.procman)
    # insert above the stretch
    self.cards_layout.insertWidget(self.cards_layout.count() - 1, card)

    # hook buttons
    card.start_clicked.connect(self.on_start)
    card.stop_clicked.connect(self.on_stop)
    card.openweb_clicked.connect(self.on_openweb)
    return card

def _auto_start_and_open(self, card: InstanceCard):
    inst = card.inst
    self.procman.start_instance(inst)

    def maybe_open():
        if self._auto_open_done:
            return
        cur = self.procman.instances.get(inst.port)
        if cur and cur.status == "RUNNING":
            self._auto_open_done = True
            self.procman.open_web(cur, self.browser_path)
            try: self.procman.status_updated.disconnect(maybe_open)
            except Exception: pass

    self.procman.status_updated.connect(maybe_open)

def on_start(self, port: int):
    inst = self.procman.instances.get(port)
    if inst: self.procman.start_instance(inst)

def on_stop(self, port: int):
    inst = self.procman.instances.get(port)
    if inst: self.procman.stop_instance_async(inst)

def on_openweb(self, port: int):
    inst = self.procman.instances.get(port)
    if inst: self.procman.open_web(inst, self.browser_path)

@QtCore.Slot()
def refresh(self):
    for i in range(self.cards_layout.count() - 1):
        w = self.cards_layout.itemAt(i).widget()
        if isinstance(w, InstanceCard):
            inst = self.procman.instances.get(w.inst.port)
            if inst: w.update_view(inst)

class SettingsWidget(QtWidgets.QWidget): request_restart = QtCore.Signal(Path) def init(self, config: ConfigManager, parent=None): super().init(parent); self.config = config title = QtWidgets.QLabel("Settings"); title.setObjectName("h1") data_label = QtWidgets.QLabel("Data Directory") self.data_edit = QtWidgets.QLineEdit(str(config.data_dir or "")) self.data_edit.setPlaceholderText("Path to HyperFlow data directory") data_browse = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Browse…"); data_browse.clicked.connect(self.on_browse) grid = QtWidgets.QGridLayout(); grid.addWidget(data_label,0,0); grid.addWidget(self.data_edit,0,1); grid.addWidget(data_browse,0,2) info = QtWidgets.QLabel("Changing the data directory will restart the launcher.") save_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Apply & Restart"); save_btn.clicked.connect(self.apply_and_restart) card = QtWidgets.QFrame(); card.setObjectName("card"); card.setAttribute(QtCore.Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True) card_l = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(card); card_l.addLayout(grid); card_l.addWidget(info); card_l.addStretch(); card_l.addWidget(save_btn, alignment=QtCore.Qt.AlignRight) v = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(self); v.addWidget(title); v.addSpacing(8); v.addWidget(card, 1) def on_browse(self): d = QtWidgets.QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "Select Data Directory") if d: self.data_edit.setText(d) def apply_and_restart(self): new_path = Path(self.data_edit.text().strip()) if not new_path.exists(): QtWidgets.QMessageBox.warning(self, "Invalid Path", "The selected path does not exist."); return self.request_restart.emit(new_path)

class Sidebar(QtWidgets.QFrame): indexChanged = QtCore.Signal(int) def init(self, parent=None): super().init(parent); self.setObjectName("sidebar") self.btn_hf = QtWidgets.QPushButton("HyperFlow"); self.btn_hf.setCheckable(True); self.btn_hf.setObjectName("nav") self.btn_settings = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Settings"); self.btn_settings.setCheckable(True); self.btn_settings.setObjectName("nav") self.btn_hf.clicked.connect(lambda: self._activate(0)); self.btn_settings.clicked.connect(lambda: self._activate(1)) top_box = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(); top_box.setContentsMargins(12,12,12,12); top_box.setSpacing(8); top_box.addWidget(self.btn_hf) bottom_box = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(); bottom_box.setContentsMargins(12,12,12,12); bottom_box.setSpacing(8); bottom_box.addWidget(self.btn_settings) v = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(self); v.setContentsMargins(0,0,0,0); v.setSpacing(0) top_wrap = QtWidgets.QFrame(); top_wrap.setObjectName("sidebarSection"); top_wrap.setLayout(top_box) bottom_wrap = QtWidgets.QFrame(); bottom_wrap.setObjectName("sidebarSection"); bottom_wrap.setLayout(bottom_box) v.addWidget(top_wrap); v.addStretch(1); v.addWidget(bottom_wrap) self._activate(0) def _activate(self, idx: int): self.btn_hf.setChecked(idx == 0); self.btn_settings.setChecked(idx == 1); self.indexChanged.emit(idx)

class MainWindow(QtWidgets.QMainWindow): def init(self, config: ConfigManager): super().init() self.config = config self.setWindowTitle(APP_NAME) self.setWindowIcon(app_icon())

    self.sidebar = Sidebar(); self.sidebar.indexChanged.connect(self.on_sidebar_index)
    self.procman = ProcessManagerLocal(config.data_dir)
    self.page_hf = HyperFlowPage(self.procman, config.browser_path)
    self.page_settings = SettingsWidget(config); self.page_settings.request_restart.connect(self.on_request_restart)

    self.stack = QtWidgets.QStackedWidget(); self.stack.addWidget(self.page_hf); self.stack.addWidget(self.page_settings)

    content_wrap = QtWidgets.QFrame(); content_wrap.setObjectName("content")
    content_layout = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(content_wrap); content_layout.setContentsMargins(16,16,16,16); content_layout.addWidget(self.stack)

    central = QtWidgets.QWidget(); h = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout(central); h.setContentsMargins(0,0,0,0); h.setSpacing(0)
    h.addWidget(self.sidebar); h.addWidget(content_wrap, 1); self.setCentralWidget(central)

    self._create_tray()
    self.resize(1120, 720)
    self._apply_qss()

def _apply_qss(self):
    self.setStyleSheet(QSS)

def on_sidebar_index(self, idx: int): self.stack.setCurrentIndex(idx)

def _create_tray(self):
    self.tray = QtWidgets.QSystemTrayIcon(self)
    self.tray.setIcon(app_icon())
    self.tray.setToolTip(APP_NAME)
    self.tray.activated.connect(self.on_tray_activated)
    menu = QtWidgets.QMenu()
    show_act = menu.addAction("Show Window")
    quit_act = menu.addAction("Quit")
    show_act.triggered.connect(self.show_normal_from_tray)
    quit_act.triggered.connect(self.quit_app)
    self.tray.setContextMenu(menu)
    self.tray.show()

def on_tray_activated(self, reason):
    if reason == QtWidgets.QSystemTrayIcon.DoubleClick:
        self.show_normal_from_tray()

def show_normal_from_tray(self):
    self.show()
    self.setWindowState(self.windowState() & ~QtCore.Qt.WindowMinimized | QtCore.Qt.WindowActive)
    self.raise_()
    self.activateWindow()

def closeEvent(self, e: QtGui.QCloseEvent):
    ret = QtWidgets.QMessageBox.question(
        self, "Exit",
        "Keep running in the system tray?\nClick 'No' to quit.",
        QtWidgets.QMessageBox.Yes | QtWidgets.QMessageBox.No,
        QtWidgets.QMessageBox.Yes
    )
    if ret == QtWidgets.QMessageBox.Yes:
        e.ignore(); self.hide()
    else:
        e.ignore(); self.quit_app()

def on_request_restart(self, new_dir: Path):
    self.config.data["data_dir"] = str(new_dir); self.config.save()
    QtWidgets.QMessageBox.information(self, "Restart Required", "Settings changed. The launcher will restart now.")
    self._restart_self()

def _restart_self(self):
    python = sys.executable; args = sys.argv[:]
    QtCore.QProcess.startDetached(python, args)
    self.quit_app(force=True)

def quit_app(self, force: bool = False):
    if force:
        QtWidgets.QApplication.quit(); return
    def _finish(): QtWidgets.QApplication.quit()
    try:
        self.procman.bulk_stop_finished.disconnect()
    except Exception:
        pass
    self.procman.bulk_stop_finished.connect(_finish)
    self.procman.kill_all_async()

notes / knobs you can tweak later

  • set real defaults via env:

    • COMFYUI_WORKDIR (e.g., /opt/comfyui)

    • COMFYUI_EXEC (e.g., bash -lc "source ~/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate comfy && python main.py --listen --port {port}")

    • BROWSER_PATH (defaults to /path/to/chrome; or patch config.data["browser_path"])

  • the Open Web button only enables once the port is actually listening.

  • logs stream live into the console (and also append to <data_dir>/logs/*.log).

  • the instance list is scrollable and won’t grow the window height.

  • clean shutdown: all QProcess children and spawned browser PIDs are terminated before exit.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

import os
import sys
import socket
import signal
import json
import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, Optional, List
from importlib import resources

from PySide6 import QtCore, QtGui, QtWidgets

from .ansi import ansi_to_html
from .qss_light import QSS

# ----------------------- App Constants -----------------------

APP_NAME = "HyperFlow Launcher"
CONFIG_PATH = str(Path.home() / ".hyperflow_launcher.json")

# Overridable via environment variables
COMFYUI_WORKDIR = os.environ.get("COMFYUI_WORKDIR", "/opt/comfyui")
COMFYUI_EXEC = os.environ.get("COMFYUI_EXEC", "python3 main.py --listen --port {port}")
BROWSER_DEFAULT = os.environ.get("BROWSER_PATH", "/path/to/chrome")

BIND_ADDR = "127.0.0.1"
MAX_INSTANCES = 8

# ----------------------- Utilities -----------------------

def app_icon() -> QtGui.QIcon:
    """Load icon from package assets; fallback to system icon if not found."""
    try:
        icon_data = (resources.files(__package__) / "assets" / "icon.png").read_bytes()
        pm = QtGui.QPixmap()
        if pm.loadFromData(icon_data):
            return QtGui.QIcon(pm)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return QtWidgets.QApplication.style().standardIcon(QtWidgets.QStyle.SP_ComputerIcon)

def is_port_in_use(port: int, host: str = BIND_ADDR, timeout: float = 0.2) -> bool:
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
        s.settimeout(timeout)
        try:
            return s.connect_ex((host, port)) == 0
        except OSError:
            return False

def reserve_free_port(host: str = BIND_ADDR) -> int:
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
    s.bind((host, 0))
    port = s.getsockname()[1]
    s.close()
    return port

# ----------------------- Data Model -----------------------

@dataclass
class Instance:
    name: str
    port: int
    cwd: Path = field(default_factory=Path)
    log_path: Path = field(default_factory=Path)
    proc: Optional[QtCore.QProcess] = None
    pid: Optional[int] = None
    chrome_pids: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)
    status: str = "STOPPED"  # STARTING / RUNNING / STOPPED
    log_fh: Optional[object] = None      # optional: also persist stream to file

# ----------------------- Config -----------------------

class ConfigManager:
    """Handle load/save of persistent user settings (data_dir, browser_path)."""

    def __init__(self, path: str):
        self.path = path
        self.data = {"data_dir": "", "browser_path": BROWSER_DEFAULT}
        self.load()

    def load(self):
        if not os.path.exists(self.path):
            return
        try:
            with open(self.path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                self.data.update(json.load(f))
        except Exception:
            self.data = {"data_dir": "", "browser_path": BROWSER_DEFAULT}

    def save(self):
        with open(self.path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(self.data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

    @property
    def data_dir(self) -> Optional[Path]:
        dd = self.data.get("data_dir", "")
        return Path(dd) if dd else None

    @property
    def browser_path(self) -> str:
        return self.data.get("browser_path") or BROWSER_DEFAULT

# ----------------------- Process Manager (QProcess streaming) -----------------------

class ProcessManagerLocal(QtCore.QObject):
    """Manage local child processes for HyperFlow instances using QProcess."""

    status_updated = QtCore.Signal()
    bulk_stop_finished = QtCore.Signal()
    log_received = QtCore.Signal(int, str)   # (port, text)

    def __init__(self, data_dir: Path, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.data_dir = data_dir
        self.instances: Dict[int, Instance] = {}
        (self.data_dir / "instances").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (self.data_dir / "logs").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (self.data_dir / "tmp").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        # Fast poll so STARTING→RUNNING flips when port is listening
        self.poll_timer = QtCore.QTimer(self)
        self.poll_timer.timeout.connect(self.poll_status)
        self.poll_timer.start(800)

        self._bulk_stop_check_timer: Optional[QtCore.QTimer] = None

    def create_instance(self) -> Instance:
        if len(self.instances) >= MAX_INSTANCES:
            raise RuntimeError("Maximum number of instances reached.")
        port = reserve_free_port(BIND_ADDR)
        if is_port_in_use(port):
            port = reserve_free_port(BIND_ADDR)
        name = f"HyperFlow-{port}"
        cwd = self.data_dir / "instances" / name
        cwd.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        log_path = self.data_dir / "logs" / f"{name}.log"
        inst = Instance(name=name, port=port, cwd=cwd, log_path=log_path)
        self.instances[port] = inst
        return inst

    def start_instance(self, inst: Instance):
        if inst.proc and inst.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning:
            return
        if is_port_in_use(inst.port):
            new_port = reserve_free_port(BIND_ADDR)
            if is_port_in_use(new_port):
                QtWidgets.QMessageBox.critical(None, "Port Error", "Failed to acquire a free port. Please try again.")
                return
            inst.port = new_port

        cmd = COMFYUI_EXEC.format(port=inst.port)

        p = QtCore.QProcess(self)
        p.setWorkingDirectory(COMFYUI_WORKDIR)
        p.setProcessChannelMode(QtCore.QProcess.MergedChannels)
        p.setProgram("/bin/bash")
        p.setArguments(["-lc", cmd])

        def _on_ready():
            try:
                data = bytes(p.readAllStandardOutput()).decode("utf-8", "ignore")
            except Exception:
                return
            if not data:
                return
            if inst.log_fh is None:
                try:
                    inst.log_fh = open(inst.log_path, "a", encoding="utf-8")
                except Exception:
                    inst.log_fh = None
            if inst.log_fh:
                try:
                    inst.log_fh.write(data)
                    inst.log_fh.flush()
                except Exception:
                    pass
            self.log_received.emit(inst.port, data)

        def _on_finished(code, status):
            if inst.log_fh:
                try:
                    inst.log_fh.close()
                except Exception:
                    pass
                inst.log_fh = None
            inst.proc = None
            inst.pid = None
            inst.status = "STOPPED"
            for pid in list(inst.chrome_pids):
                try:
                    os.kill(pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                except ProcessLookupError:
                    pass
            inst.chrome_pids.clear()
            self.status_updated.emit()

        p.readyReadStandardOutput.connect(_on_ready)
        p.finished.connect(_on_finished)

        inst.status = "STARTING"
        p.start()
        if not p.waitForStarted(3000):
            QtWidgets.QMessageBox.critical(None, "Start Error", "Failed to start process.")
            inst.status = "STOPPED"
            return
        inst.proc = p
        inst.pid = int(p.processId()) if p.processId() is not None else None
        self.status_updated.emit()

    def stop_instance_async(self, inst: Instance, timeout_sec: float = 5.0):
        if not inst.proc:
            return
        try:
            inst.proc.terminate()  # graceful
        except Exception:
            pass
        pid = inst.pid

        def _force_kill():
            if inst.proc and inst.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning:
                if pid:
                    try:
                        os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                    except ProcessLookupError:
                        pass
                try:
                    inst.proc.kill()
                except Exception:
                    pass

        QtCore.QTimer.singleShot(int(timeout_sec * 1000), _force_kill)

    def kill_all_async(self, timeout_sec: float = 5.0):
        running = [i for i in self.instances.values()
                   if i.proc and i.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning]
        if not running:
            QtCore.QTimer.singleShot(0, self.bulk_stop_finished.emit)
            return

        if self._bulk_stop_check_timer is None:
            self._bulk_stop_check_timer = QtCore.QTimer(self)

        self._bulk_stop_check_timer.setInterval(300)

        def _tick():
            alive = [i for i in self.instances.values()
                     if i.proc and i.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning]
            if not alive:
                self._bulk_stop_check_timer.stop()
                self.bulk_stop_finished.emit()

        try:
            self._bulk_stop_check_timer.timeout.disconnect()
        except Exception:
            pass
        self._bulk_stop_check_timer.timeout.connect(_tick)
        self._bulk_stop_check_timer.start()

        for inst in running:
            self.stop_instance_async(inst, timeout_sec)

    def poll_status(self):
        changed = False
        for inst in self.instances.values():
            prev = inst.status
            if not inst.proc or inst.proc.state() == QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning:
                if prev != "STOPPED":
                    inst.status = "STOPPED"
                    changed = True
                continue
            inst.status = "RUNNING" if is_port_in_use(inst.port) else "STARTING"
            if inst.status != prev:
                changed = True
        if changed:
            self.status_updated.emit()

    def open_web(self, inst: Instance, browser_path: str):
        url = f"http://localhost:{inst.port}"
        try:
            p = subprocess.Popen([browser_path, url])
            inst.chrome_pids.append(p.pid)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            QtWidgets.QMessageBox.warning(
                None, "Browser Not Found",
                f"The browser path is invalid:\n{browser_path}"
            )

class InstanceCard(QtWidgets.QFrame):
    """One instance with actions and an embedded collapsible console."""

    start_clicked = QtCore.Signal(int)
    stop_clicked = QtCore.Signal(int)
    openweb_clicked = QtCore.Signal(int)

    def __init__(self, inst: Instance, procman: ProcessManagerLocal, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.inst = inst
        self.procman = procman
        self.setObjectName("card")
        self.setAttribute(QtCore.Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)

        self._anim_tick = 0  # for STARTING... animation

        name_lbl = QtWidgets.QLabel(f"{inst.name}")
        name_lbl.setObjectName("h2")
        self.subtitle = QtWidgets.QLabel(self._subtitle_text())
        self.subtitle.setObjectName("subtle")

        self.start_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Start")
        self.stop_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Stop")
        self.web_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Open Web")

        self.start_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self.start_clicked.emit(inst.port))
        self.stop_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self.stop_clicked.emit(inst.port))
        self.web_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self.openweb_clicked.emit(inst.port))

        # Console toggle + view
        self.console_toggle = QtWidgets.QToolButton()
        self.console_toggle.setObjectName("consoleToggle")
        self.console_toggle.setText("Console")
        self.console_toggle.setCheckable(True)
        self.console_toggle.setArrowType(QtCore.Qt.RightArrow)
        self.console_toggle.setToolButtonStyle(QtCore.Qt.ToolButtonTextBesideIcon)
        self.console_toggle.toggled.connect(self._on_console_toggled)

        self.console_view = QtWidgets.QTextBrowser()
        self.console_view.setObjectName("console")
        self.console_view.setReadOnly(True)
        self.console_view.setHidden(True)
        self.console_view.document().setMaximumBlockCount(5000)
        self.console_view.setAutoFillBackground(False)

        header = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout()
        header.addWidget(name_lbl)
        header.addStretch()
        header.addWidget(self.subtitle)

        actions = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout()
        actions.addStretch()
        actions.addWidget(self.start_btn)
        actions.addWidget(self.stop_btn)
        actions.addWidget(self.web_btn)
        actions.addWidget(self.console_toggle)

        v = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(self)
        v.addLayout(header)
        v.addLayout(actions)
        v.addWidget(self.console_view)

        # STARTING animation timer
        self.anim_timer = QtWidgets.QTimer(self)
        self.anim_timer.setInterval(1000)
        self.anim_timer.timeout.connect(self._animate_starting)
        self._sync_anim_timer()

        # connect live logs (even when console is collapsed)
        self.procman.log_received.connect(self._on_log)

        self.update_buttons()

    def _subtitle_text(self) -> str:
        if self.inst.status == "STARTING":
            dots = "." * ((self._anim_tick % 3) + 1)
            return f"Port {self.inst.port} • Status: STARTING{dots}"
        return f"Port {self.inst.port} • Status: {self.inst.status}"

    def _sync_anim_timer(self):
        if self.inst.status == "STARTING" and not self.anim_timer.isActive():
            self.anim_timer.start()
        elif self.inst.status != "STARTING" and self.anim_timer.isActive():
            self.anim_timer.stop()

    def _animate_starting(self):
        if self.inst.status != "STARTING":
            self._sync_anim_timer()
            return
        self._anim_tick += 1
        self.subtitle.setText(self._subtitle_text())

    def _on_console_toggled(self, checked: bool):
        self.console_toggle.setArrowType(
            QtCore.Qt.DownArrow if checked else QtCore.Qt.RightArrow
        )
        self.console_view.setHidden(not checked)

    @QtCore.Slot(int, str)
    def _on_log(self, port: int, text: str):
        if port != self.inst.port:
            return
        html = ansi_to_html(text)
        self.console_view.moveCursor(QtGui.QTextCursor.End)
        self.console_view.insertHtml(html)
        self.console_view.moveCursor(QtGui.QTextCursor.End)

    def update_view(self, inst: Instance):
        self.inst = inst
        self._sync_anim_timer()
        self.subtitle.setText(self._subtitle_text())
        self.update_buttons()

    def update_buttons(self):
        running = self.inst.status == "RUNNING"
        starting = self.inst.status == "STARTING"
        self.start_btn.setEnabled(not running and not starting)
        self.stop_btn.setEnabled(running or starting)
        self.web_btn.setEnabled(running)
